Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

elorian hss · evaluates: HSS uses an LLM judge given the question, reference answer and model answer to mark each rubric criterion; the documented headline accuracy counts a task correct only when every criterion is met.

candidate.next12.hss.rubric-scoring.v2

  • The card identifies Claude Opus 5 as the paper’s judge. No judge agreement or benchmark performance is newly measured here.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

elorian hss · benchmark task: HSS evaluates video tasks on the whole video; the documented evidence-window timestamps are analysis metadata and are not part of the model input.

candidate.next12.hss.video-window.v2

  • The timestamps do not justify a claim that models were supplied only answer-bearing clips. No videos or complete frame sequences were played by this author.
